title: Disposition of collected fines and penalties.
bodyText: Fines and penalties collected under sections 342J-9 and 342J-10 shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2.
bodyHtml: [§342J-10.5]  Disposition of collected fines and penalties.  Fines and penalties collected under sections 342J-9 and 342J-10 shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2. [L 1991, c 157, §5]
